C3H6O can be represented by different structural isomers. Here are the possible ones:

1. Propanal (an aldehyde)
2. Acetone (a ketone)
3. Prop-1-en-2-ol (an enol)
4. 2-Propen-1-ol (an allyl alcohol)
5. Cyclopropanol (a cyclic alcohol)
6. Methyl vinyl ether (an ether)

These are typical structural isomers for C3H6O. Therefore, the number of structural isomers is 6.
